views.markdown: **The iOS 26 Control Center for iOS 16.** Liquid glass controls, a real edit mode and pages, all inside Apple's own Control Center.

- Tap **+** at the top to edit: controls glow instead of wiggle.
- **Hold and drag** any control anywhere on a 4 × 7 grid, gaps allowed.
- **Resize** with the corner handle, remove with the **−** badge.
- **Add a Control** sheet, including extra copies of Connectivity and Music.
- **Layout presets**: save layouts and switch between them.

- Up to **6 pages**, each its own 4 × 7 grid. Swipe up and down to snap between them.
- Page icons on the right: tap one, or slide along them to jump.
- Add a page while editing; empty pages remove themselves.

- **Connectivity** at 2×2, 4×4, 4×6 or 4×7 with labeled cards (Wi-Fi network, AirDrop, Cellular, Bluetooth, Hotspot). Tap the Wi-Fi or Bluetooth arrows to open their settings.
- **Music** at 2×2, 4×2, 4×4, 4×6 or 4×7: artwork, scrubber, love, volume and AirPlay. The sliders move like Apple's: they grow while you hold them and stretch at the ends.

- Liquid glass music module with artwork and a round AirPlay button
- Colored slider icons with bounce, jelly buttons
- **Slide to power off** from the power button at the top
- Controls drop in one by one when Control Center opens
- Settings > Control Center redesigned like iOS 18, with **Reset Control Center**

views.text: Made by nano · iPhone 13 Pro Max tested

views.markdown:
- **iOS 18 / iOS 26 look** switch, plus round module shapes
- Works on smaller iPhones: no more overlapping connectivity controls or stray lines
- **Redesigned settings** with a header and sections
- Bug fixes

- Apple's AirDrop icon on the big Connectivity cards
- Wi-Fi and Bluetooth arrows open their settings
- Smoother page switching: hold and slide along the page icons, controls shrink while the header and buttons stay put
- Music sliders work like Apple's (no jumping to your finger, grow while held, stretch at the ends) and no longer flicker
- 4x2 music player buttons centered
- Big Music / Connectivity disappear instantly when Control Center closes
- Hold and drag works from anywhere on a control in edit mode
- Apple's AirPlay / pause icons stay hidden after opening the player
First official release: edit mode, pages, big layouts, presets, opening animation and the new Control Center settings page.
